representative_scale.selection: One fixed scale required by brief; no scale search, no doubling.
representative_scale.source: brief.md, Scale (operator revision after raid jackhammer)
representative_scale.setup: Set host nOptions = 1024 * 1024 and rebuild once with baseline build commands.
representative_scale.validation: Check printed GPU count, option count and path count; tiny GPU adjustment can reduce options on <=32-core devices and would invalidate requested scale.
representative_scale.budget_behavior: If fixed scale exceeds stage budget, report timeout; do not reduce scale.

inputs.data: Generated parameters and cuRAND paths described in data.json

scoring_interface.anchor_checks: Run published 8192-option configuration for anchors.json; preserve unrounded reserve predicate via verdict at rounding boundary.
scoring_interface.representative_scoring: Report Total time (ms.) for 1048576 options, 262144 paths per option, one GPU. Record correctness statistics and process status.

runtime_feasibility.reason: Brief provides no measured runtime at fixed representative scale. Budget compliance and reaching 10 seconds remain unverified; no workloads authorized during intake.
